faqSection.title: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW
faqSection.subtitle: Clear, straightforward answers about our production process, billing terms, revisions, and studio rentals.

contactCard.text: Have a custom campaign brief or need custom multi-format deliverables?

faq.q: What is the typical turnaround timeline for a Brand Sprint or Video Shoot?
faq.a: Brand Sprints are typically delivered within 10 to 14 business days from kickoff. Commercial Video spots range from 2 to 3 weeks including storyboard approval, studio shoot, and master color grading. Rapid 48-hour sprint deliveries are available for urgent campaigns upon request.

faq.q: How does milestone-based billing and deposit work?
faq.a: All project packaging requires a 50% deposit upon kickoff and brief signoff. The remaining 50% is released only after your team reviews and approves the final high-resolution deliverables and master files.

faq.q: Do we receive full raw footage and master vector source files?
faq.a: Yes. Upon final settlement, all project deliverables include complete master vectors, open project files (Figma / Illustrator), high-bitrate ProRes/H.265 master exports, and raw camera assets upon request.

faq.q: How many revision rounds are included in standard packaging?
faq.a: Each project package includes 2 structured rounds of revisions during rough-cut and draft milestones. Our collaborative digital review portal lets your team drop timecode-precise comments directly onto video frames or design boards.

faq.q: Can we rent the Cyclorama Studio and equipment for independent shoots?
faq.a: Yes. Our 450 m² facility is available for hourly and full-day leases. Rental includes access to our ARRI SkyPanel lighting grid, makeup suite, high-speed fiber internet, and an on-site technical assistant.

faq.q: What aspect ratios and video export formats do you provide?
faq.a: We deliver master 16:9 landscape cuts for YouTube and web, 9:16 vertical cuts for TikTok and Instagram Reels, and 1:1 / 4:5 square crops for paid ad platforms, all color-calibrated for OLED and mobile screens.

faq.q: How does the Monthly Content Retainer operate?
faq.a: Retainers provide a dedicated monthly creative capacity delivering 20 social assets and 4 cinematic short-form video reels per month. There is zero long-term lock-in contract, and unused sprint credits roll over for 30 days.

faq.q: Which payment methods and currencies do you support?
faq.a: We accept all major credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and wire transfers via Stripe for international clients. Indonesian clients can settle via BCA, Mandiri, BNI Virtual Accounts and QRIS.
